title: Household Energy Consumption and Recycling Rates in Four Countries (2010–2020)
prompt: The chart below shows the average annual household energy consumption (in megawatt-hours, MWh) in four countries between 2010 and 2020. The table below shows the percentage of household waste recycled in the same four countries in 2010 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先仔细阅读图表和表格，注意单位（MWh 和百分比）以及时间范围（2010–2020）。写作时，先概述主要趋势和对比，再分段描述具体数据。不要加入个人观点或原因分析。确保字数不少于150词。
